analysisComplete: Analysis complete: {elements, plural, one {# element analysed} other {# elements analysed}}, {errors, plural, =0 {no error} one {# error} other {# errors}} and {warnings, plural, =0 {no warning} one {# warning} other {# warnings}} found.
simulationCouldNotStart: Cannot start the simulation: {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} during {step, select, preCompilation {pre-compilation} other {compilation}}.
simulationCrashed: Simulation stopped. Error while running the PLC cycle.

save.storageFull: Cannot save: the browser storage is full. Export the project to a file so you don't lose your work.
save.storageUnavailable: Cannot save: the browser storage is unavailable (private browsing?). Export the project to a file.
save.cloudUnreachable: Cannot save to the cloud: check your connection and that you are signed in. Export the project to a file so you don't lose your work.
save.conflict: This project was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload the online version or save your changes under another name.
save.generic: Cannot save. Export the project to a file so you don't lose your work.

draftCorrupted: The draft is corrupted and could not be opened.
cloudReloadFailed: Could not reload the online version of the project.
projectReloadFailed: Could not load the saved project.
shareLinkFailed: Could not create the share link.
moveToCloudConflict: A cloud project with this identifier already exists, probably sent from another device.
moveToCloudFailed: The project could not be sent to the cloud. Check your connection.
shareLoginPrompt: Sign in to share this project.
pasteWrongScope: Cannot paste here: the clipboard holds elements from a different kind of page.
hardwareLinkLost: Link with the board lost. Its outputs went back to the fallback state.

hardwareLinkFailed.handshake-timeout: The board does not answer: the Studomate firmware is not installed on it.
hardwareLinkFailed.protocol-mismatch: The firmware of the board is not compatible with this version of Studomate.
hardwareLinkFailed.config-rejected: The board rejected the pin configuration.
hardwareLinkFailed.transport: Cannot communicate with the board. Check the USB cable, and that no other program or tab (Studomate included) is using the port.
hardwareLinkFailed.firmware-outdated: The firmware of the board is too old for this version of Studomate.

hardwareProgramUploaded: Program transferred. The board now runs it by itself: you can unplug the USB cable.

hardwareProgramBlocked.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The program is too large for the board: {size} bytes for {limit} available.
hardwareProgramBlocked.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE_WITH_PROGRAM: The program is too large for the board: {size} bytes for {limit} available. The largest program is "{program}" ({programSize} bytes).
hardwareProgramBlocked.VARIABLE_MEMORY_EXCEEDED: The variables need {size} bytes of memory, the board offers {limit}.
hardwareProgramBlocked.STACK_TOO_DEEP: An expression is too deep for the board (depth {depth}, maximum {limit}). Split it.
hardwareProgramBlocked.CALL_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: Programs call each other too deeply for the board (depth {depth}, maximum {limit}).
hardwareProgramBlocked.JUMP_NESTING_EXCEEDED: Conditions are nested too deeply for the board (maximum {limit} levels).

hardwareProgramFailed.analysis: Fix the errors reported by the analysis before sending the program to the board.
hardwareProgramFailed.compilation: The project does not compile: the program cannot be sent to the board.
hardwareProgramFailed.unsupported: The project uses a feature the board cannot run.
hardwareProgramFailed.upload-timeout: The board stopped answering while receiving the program. Try again.
hardwareProgramFailed.upload-mismatch: The board did not store the program it was sent. Try again.
hardwareProgramFailed.transport: Cannot communicate with the board. Check the USB cable.

hardwareProgramCommandFailed.upload-rejected: The board could not start its program: it holds no valid program, or lacks memory for it.
hardwareProgramCommandFailed.upload-timeout: The board did not answer. Try again.
hardwareProgramCommandFailed.upload-mismatch: The board did not answer as expected. Try again.
hardwareProgramCommandFailed.transport: Cannot communicate with the board. Check the USB cable.

hardwareOutputsCutInBackground: Tab in the background: the outputs of the board were cut.

hardwareFlashFailed.sync-failed: Cannot install the firmware: the board does not answer. Check that no other program is using the port. Only the original Arduino Uno R3 is supported.
hardwareFlashFailed.protocol-error: Cannot install the firmware: unexpected answer from the board. Only the original Arduino Uno R3 is supported.
hardwareFlashFailed.unsupported-board: Cannot install the firmware: this board is not an Arduino Uno R3.
hardwareFlashFailed.verify-failed: The firmware installation failed: verification found differences. Try again.
hardwareFlashFailed.transport: Cannot install the firmware: communication with the board was interrupted.
hardwareFlashFailed.firmware-unavailable: Cannot install the firmware: the firmware file was not found.
